title: Acceptance gating & sequencing — order form to MSA/DPA mapping (NovaCare pilot)
text:
Acceptance gating & sequencing — order form to MSA/DPA mapping (NovaCare pilot)

["From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@novacare.health>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@novacare.health>, LegalOps <legalops@novacare.health>
Date: 2025-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot MAP + order form dependencies (NovaCare)

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the NovaCare pilot team is aligned on scope and wants to lock down procurement sequencing so we can meet our internal go/no-go in early September. Attached is a draft order form and our preferred procurement timeline.

Two asks to start:
- Can you map which order-form fields we should expect to change as a result of MSA vs order form negotiation (pricing, billing contact, termination, acceptance signoff)?
- From your experience, which items should be gated behind MSA signature vs which can be captured in the order form / SOW to avoid blocking the pilot start?

We'd like a proposed MAP (tasks + owners + target dates) from Redwood so I can share with our LegalOps and Procurement.

Attached: novacare_orderform_draft.pdf (draft order form), NovaCare_procurement_timeline.xlsx (procurement target dates)

Best,
Ava Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
NovaCare Health
", "From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@novacare.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-15T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + order form dependencies (NovaCare)

Thanks Ava — useful context. We can definitely produce a concise MAP showing which items must complete before pilot start and which can be templated in the order form to speed signature. High level proposal below (we'll attach an editable MAP):

Proposed sequencing (high-level):
1) Legal review (MSA) — Redline + commentary (target: 7 business days)
2) DPA review — run in parallel to MSA where possible; rely on DPA appendix in MSA and supplementary order-form fields for region-specific controls
3) Order form / SOW finalization — binds pricing, pilot SOW, acceptance criteria, billing contact
4) Security evidence handoff — provide SOC2, controls index, and any requested artifacts to LegalOps (see attachment list)
5) Signature & pilot kickoff — once MSA redline reconciled and order form SOW accepted

Proposed acceptance gating items (will include in MAP spreadsheet):
- Data ingestion validated (test dataset)
- Throughput/latency verification for target workload
- Pilot success metrics (precision/recall / uptime threshold)
- Final signoff owner identified in order form SOW

Estimated timeline: 4-6 weeks if MSA/DPA reviews happen in parallel; target earliest signature: week of 2025-09-01. If legal requires sequential gating, add 1-2 weeks.

Attachments: NovaCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (editable MAP), redwood_orderform_draft_20250814.pdf

Questions for you: who is our billing contact for NovaCare? Any procurement constraints on auto-renew or payment terms we should avoid in the order form SOW?

I'll loop in Karthik for the pricing/quantization notes.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Strategic Accounts Manager
Redwood Inference
", "From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@novacare.health>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + order form dependencies (NovaCare)

Ava / team — quick operational notes to add to the MAP before we share it with NovaCare LegalOps:

Operational gating items to include (explicit rows in the MAP):
- Milestone 1: Data ingest validated and schema signoff (owner: NovaCare eng)
- Milestone 2: Pilot metric thresholds (owner: NovaCare product + Redwood delivery)
- Milestone 3: Pilot acceptance signoff (owner: NovaCare program manager)
- Milestone 4: Billing contact and invoicing cadence confirmed (owner: NovaCare procurement)

Legal/controls:
- We'll provide a security-evidence-index.csv that maps SOC2 controls to evidence artifacts (this should satisfy most DPA review asks up front).
- Recommend a DPA appendix that can be attached to the MSA so we can avoid a separate DPA signature path that blocks the order form.

Commercials:
- Include a short canary clause for the pilot billing period (standard pilot discount + clause to convert to committed usage within X days of acceptance)
- Avoid open auto-renew language for the pilot order form; propose explicit term and renewal options in the order form SOW.

Karthik — can you confirm the estimated token/compute profile for the pilot so we can attach a cost proxy in the MAP?

Link: Internal runbook (contracts) — https://redwood.internal/runbooks/procurement-onramp (internal)

Attachments we will upload: security-evidence-index.csv (controls/index), NovaCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with above gates)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Contracting, Redwood Inference
", "From: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@novacare.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Patel <ava.patel@novacare.health>, LegalOps <legalops@novacare.health>
Date: 2025-08-18T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + order form dependencies (NovaCare)

Thanks all — appreciate the clear sequencing. Quick confirmation from Procurement/LegalOps side:

- We can target signature of the MSA + order form by 2025-09-05 if Redwood can provide:
  * MSA redline back to us by 2025-08-22
  * SOC2 report and the security-evidence-index.csv by 2025-08-20
  * A finalized order form (PDF/DocuSign-ready) by 2025-08-25

- Procurement notes: we'll need a dedicated billing contact for invoicing and a purchase order (we'll issue PO upon signature). Please confirm if Redwood requires net-30, net-45, or if pilot invoice will be prepaid.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/novacare/orderform/abc123 (order form envelope prepared)

Forwarding the procurement timeline we shared internally (attached): Novacare_procurement_timeline.xlsx

If Redwood can meet these deliverables we'll proceed with LegalOps review in parallel and aim to keep the pilot kickoff window intact.

Best,
Jordan Reed
Sr. Procurement Partner
NovaCare Health
"]
